title: Canal+ taps Google's AI for video production, content recommendation
title_zh: Canal+ 利用 Google 人工智能进行视频制作和内容推荐
summary: French media group Canal+ on Wednesday said it had struck a ‌multi-year partnership with Alphabet's Google Cloud to ‌deploy generative artificial intelligence across its production operations and streaming ​platform.
summary_zh: 法国媒体集团 Canal+ 周三表示，它已与 Alphabet 的谷歌云达成多年合作伙伴关系，在其制作业务和流媒体平台上部署生成人工智能。

title: Oracle sees AI boom through at least 2027, sending shares up 8%
title_zh: 甲骨文预计人工智能至少会在 2027 年蓬勃发展，股价上涨 8%
summary: STORY: :: OracleOracle on Tuesday predicted that the AI data center boom will power its revenue above Wall Street estimates well into 2027.That sent shares in the firm up over 8% in extended trading.Oracle reported third quarter revenue of just over $17 billion, beating estima...
summary_zh: 故事：：甲骨文周二预测，人工智能数据中心的繁荣将推动其收入在 2027 年远高于华尔街的预期。这使得该公司的股价在盘后交易中上涨超过 8%。甲骨文公布的第三季度收入略高于 170 亿美元，超出了预期...

title: Nintendo Shares Soar 10% as Surprise Hit Pokémon Game Lifts Mood
title_zh: 神奇宝贝游戏出人意料提振情绪，任天堂股价飙升 10%
summary: The rally comes as physical copies of Pokémon Pokopia, released exclusively for the Switch 2 console on March 5, have sold out at several major retailers in the US.
summary_zh: 此次集会正值 3 月 5 日专为 Switch 2 主机发售的《精灵宝可梦 Pokopia》实体版在美国几家主要零售商处售空。

title: SoftBank's PayPay plans to price US IPO around low end of range, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，软银旗下 PayPay 计划将美国 IPO 定价定在区间低端附近
summary: The initial public offering of SoftBank's PayPay is likely to price around the low end of ‌its marketing range as war in the Middle East roils markets, two people ‌familiar with the matter said.
summary_zh: 两位知情人士表示，由于中东战争扰乱市场，软银旗下 PayPay 的首次公开募股定价可能会在其营销区间的低端附近。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip amid continued Iran fallout, with CPI on deck
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货因伊朗局势持续下滑，消费者物价指数 (CPI) 上涨
summary: Wall Street continues to be buffeted by the winds of war, as the effects of the Iran war are being seen through widespread volatility.
summary_zh: 华尔街继续受到战争之风的打击，伊朗战争的影响正在通过广泛的波动显现出来。

title: Wall St closes mixed on ramped-up Middle East tensions
title_zh: 中东紧张局势加剧，华尔街收盘涨跌互现

title: Microsoft backs Anthropic in amicus brief to halt US DOD's 'supply-chain risk' designation
title_zh: 微软在法庭之友陈述中支持 Anthropic，以停止美国国防部的“供应链风险”认定
summary: Microsoft filed on Tuesday a brief in support of Anthropic's lawsuit asking the court to temporarily block the U.S. Department of Defense's ‌designation of the AI startup as a supply-chain risk.
summary_zh: 微软周二提交了一份简报，支持 Anthropic 的诉讼，要求法院暂时阻止美国国防部将这家人工智能初创公司指定为供应链风险。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500 end lower, oil slides as Wall Street weighs Iran war signals
title_zh: 今日股市：道指、标准普尔 500 指数收低，华尔街衡量伊朗战争信号，油价下跌
summary: Wall Street is adjusting to a historic spike and fall in oil prices after the global economy was thrown into disarray.
summary_zh: 全球经济陷入混乱后，华尔街正在适应油价历史性的上涨和下跌。

title: Former energy secretary Rick Perry says AI revolution hinges on 2 limitations
title_zh: 前能源部长里克·佩里表示人工智能革命取决于两个限制
summary: The former Texas governor believes the AI race will be won by energy-rich states and companies that can navigate a tightening industrial supply chain.
summary_zh: 这位前德克萨斯州州长认为，能源丰富的州和能够应对日益紧张的工业供应链的公司将赢得人工智能竞赛。
